title: Carnival balls and the music played
summary: She was more interested in music than the balls. They played Aida for the Grand March plus special arrangements.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Could you tell us a little bit about a carnival ball? What it's like?
Frankly, I don't, I wasn't too interested in the ball itself. I was more interested in the music. So I really couldn't give any information on the ball.
Well I just wondered what kind of music you'd play at a ball for example.
Well we had to play Aida and things like that for the Grand March and then we played our arrangements of which we had at that time. Different numbers that we had specially arranged.
Would you play for Rex, Pumas, Mamas? All those. All the big clubs.
They were held at that, that's the name of the band.
